root.label: Capital Markets Board shuts seven asset managers' funds

events.label: Capital Markets Board shuts seven asset managers' funds

slots.name: closed asset managers
slots.sentence: In response, the Capital Markets Board (SPK) intervened and shut down the funds of seven asset managers, including Tera, Pusula and Atlas.

slots.name: Tera fund assets
slots.sentence: Two Tera funds alone held assets totaling around €6.5 billion ($6.37 billion).

slots.name: liquidation deadline
slots.sentence: The deadline for this has been extended from three to six months.

slots.name: inflation rate
slots.sentence: Given inflation of around 30%, that is not exactly easy.

slots.name: liquidation status
slots.sentence: The funds are being liquidated: Their assets will be sold and the proceeds distributed to investors in proportion to their fund shares.
